value.text:
If the Orion E4 is at 20% and you want to charge it to 80%, the change in state of charge (SoC) is 60%. The required battery energy is calculated as 64 kWh multiplied by 0.60, which equals 38.4 kWh. 

Assuming a wall-to-battery efficiency of 90%, the grid energy required for this charge is 38.4 kWh divided by 0.90, resulting in approximately 42.67 kWh. 

At a sustained charging power of 11 kW, the time to charge from 20% to 80% would be 42.67 kWh divided by 11 kW, which equals approximately 3.88 hours, or about 3 hours and 53 minutes.
